story_zh: 我的家很大。爸爸在书房工作，用新电脑。妈妈在客厅看电视。哥哥和姐姐在房间里看书。弟弟和妹妹在桌子旁边玩。我看见我的狗和猫在椅子上睡觉。我的家有很多颜色，很漂亮。
story_pinyin: Wǒ de jiā hěn dà. Bàba zài shūfáng gōngzuò, yòng xīn diànnǎo. Māma zài kètīng kàn diànshì. Gēge hé jiějie zài fángjiān lǐ kàn shū. Dìdi hé mèimei zài zhuōzi pángbiān wán. Wǒ kànjiàn wǒ de gǒu hé māo zài yǐzi shàng shuìjiào. Wǒ de jiā yǒu hěn duō yánsè, hěn piàoliang.
story_en: My home is very big. Dad works in the study, using a new computer. Mom watches TV in the living room. My older brother and sister read books in the room. My younger brother and sister play next to the table. I see my dog and cat sleeping on the chair. My home has many colors, very beautiful.
